findings.title: tests/fixtures/proof_schema/ intermediate files not committed
findings.body: Three fixture files (bad_report_path, bad_auditor_model, bad_finding_status) were generated locally to verify the validator behavior but were not committed — the equivalent logic is covered by the TestPR839Regressions pytest class using tmp_path, so committed fixtures are not needed.

findings.title: hook only fires on proof/*/PROOF.json pattern — nested proofs (proof/sub/TP-X/PROOF.json) are not matched
findings.body: Pattern ^proof/[^/]+/PROOF\.json$ matches only top-level packet dirs. Nested proof structures (e.g. review_bundle/PROOF.json) are excluded. This matches CI validator scope behavior (which uses include_patterns from .validator_scope.json). No expansion needed now.

remaining_risks: R1: pre-commit hook does not run in CI Quality gate unless pre-commit itself passes — if pre-commit install is skipped locally, the hook is bypassed. The CI Audit Proof Validator remains the authoritative gate.
R2: Nested proof paths (e.g. review_bundle/PROOF.json) are not covered by the hook pattern. Consistent with CI scope.
R1: local hook is advisory; CI remains authoritative gate.
R2: nested proof paths excluded from hook scope (consistent with CI).
